SPIRIT 2026-27 Volleyball (Boys & Girls), Zone-5 Tournament
Tournament date: 13/08/2026. Reporting time: 07:30 AM onwards.
Venue: GIDC Degree Engineering College, Abrama, Navsari.
Last date for sending entry: 10/08/2026.
Send entries through email and fill in the Google Form link provided in the email.
Email: sports110@gdec.in
Event Sports Manager: Prof. Daksh R. Tandel. Contact: 9601047975.
Teams must arrange their own lodging and boarding.
TA/DA is borne by the participating institute.
Required documents: college ID; two passport-size photos; latest fee receipt; leaving certificate; 10th and relevant subsequent mark sheets; last-exam mark sheet; detailed eligibility proforma signed by the principal and sports I/C.
All documents must be signed by the principal, or player eligibility may be terminated at reporting.
